about: Fixed bodies for the front-door screenshots, so a dependency update or a new build moves no pixel: the launcher idle on the start screen (ten sample teams, the settings), a saved match of this release with the players where they stood, the round previewed for Oakmere Rangers at home to Eldstead City, the answer to quit during that match, and fourteen packages of the notices file. The licence texts are cut at 2,400 characters; the drive on the built page compares the full file.
